name: Vacanza
tagline: Complete 29-page Vacanza display system with its own typography, composition and layout vocabulary.

palette.description: Source-specific colors retained in native text, shapes, tables and image treatments; not normalized across templates.

typography.style: Butler display with Inter body; original source font-family roles, declared weights, sizes and frames retained. Original unmodified font files are embedded with their own licenses; font versions are recorded. No common font substitution.

best_for: Cultural and travel narratives, city stories, lifestyle presentations and lightly structured proposals with postcard typography and postal ornaments.
avoid_for: Dense technical specifications, highly compressed financial tables, or formal board reporting with little room for visual narrative.
